name: Super ZSNES
description:
SUPER ZSNES is an enhanced modern packaging of ZSNES, the legendary and nostalgic 16-bit Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES) emulator. Known for its distinctive GUI, it revives vintage SNES gaming memories.

Features:
- Classic ZSNES user interface with built-in sound effects and visual menu theme
- Accurate emulation of standard SNES titles and Super FX chip games
- Rich video filter options including Super Eagle, 2xSaI, and CRT scanlines
- Multiple save state slots, rewind capabilities, and cheat code management
- Gamepad controller support with customizable button mapping
